info.title: IronForge API
info.description: IronForge is a self-hosted Git platform written in Rust. This API provides repository management, issue tracking, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, wiki, LFS, webhooks, and more.

get.summary:
Download an LFS object: GET /repos/:owner/:name/lfs/objects/:oid
Streams the object, decompressing on the fly if compressed.
For compressed objects, uses spawn_blocking + channel for streaming
zstd decompression without blocking the async runtime.

put.summary:
Upload an LFS object: PUT /repos/:owner/:name/lfs/objects/:oid
Streams the request body directly to a temp file, then stream-compresses
it with zstd — never buffers the entire object in memory.

get.description: Downloads the release asset file and increments the download count.

Clients need a by-tag lookup that does not page through every release
(the client design doc listed this as an upstream need).

post.description:
Upload a release asset. The request body is the raw file content.
Required headers:
  - `Content-Disposition`: `attachment; filename*=UTF-8''...`
  - `Content-Type`: MIME type of the file (used as asset content_type)

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/runners/register
Register a new runner and receive a token.

POST /api/v1/runners/:id/deregister
Deregister a runner — removes it from the pool.
Auth handled by `authenticate_runner` middleware.

POST /api/v1/runners/:id/heartbeat
Update runner heartbeat (called every 30 seconds).
Auth handled by `authenticate_runner` middleware.

get.summary:
GET /api/v1/runners/:id/jobs/poll?timeout=30
Long-polling endpoint for runners to fetch jobs.
Auth handled by `authenticate_runner` middleware.

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/runners/:id/jobs/:job_id/artifacts

Auth handled by `authenticate_runner` middleware.

post.summary:
POST /users/mfa/disable
Disable MFA (requires current password for security).

Verify the setup TOTP code and enable MFA, generating backup codes.

200.description: MFA enabled successfully with backup codes

400.description: Invalid TOTP code or MFA not set up

post.summary:

Generate a new TOTP secret and return an otpauth URL + QR code SVG.

200.description: TOTP secret and QR code generated

post.summary:
POST /users/mfa/verify
Second step of login: verify MFA code and issue JWT.

400.description: Invalid or expired token, or invalid password

200.description: SSH keys for the current user
